Lyve Studio mini case study / 90-day live ramp
cam 02 · haus set
livehaus / live drop
three months. one brand. one channel.
performance (first 90 days):
  • month 1: $20K live GMV. studio build, host casting, and first shows on air.
  • month 2: $68K live GMV. 3.4x month over month as hosts and programming locked in.
  • month 3: $130K live GMV. 6.5x from month 1.
  • share of sales: live grew from 0.8% to 7% of total TikTok Shop sales, a 9x share shift in 90 days.
  • how we did it: custom multi-cam set, four trained hosts, daily shows, and every live scored on GMV/LIVE with weekly AI actionables.
